def unpack_obs(res):
    I=np.asarray(res.last[cam_name]); D=np.asarray(res.depth[cam_name])
    if I.ndim==4: I=I[-1]
    if D.ndim==3: D=D[-1]
    return I,D

def hand_point(I,D):
    cam=r.spec()
    # Current top camera extrinsics supplied with every observation; retained in r._spec is fixed.
    # OpenGL camera coordinates: x right, y up, looks along -z.
    # Pixels/depth map into world coordinates with the published calibration.
    # We use foreground hand pixels in a compact top-view ROI, excluding the green goal marker.
    c=latest_camera
    K=np.asarray(c['intrinsic_cv'],float); T=np.asarray(c['cam2world_gl'],float); f=K[0,0]; cx=K[0,2]; cy=K[1,2]
    h,w=D.shape; yy,xx=np.indices((h,w));
    green=(I[:,:,1]>1.32*I[:,:,0])&(I[:,:,1]>1.20*I[:,:,2])&(I[:,:,1]>65)
    mask=(D>.68)&(D<1.075)&(xx>=128)&(xx<=193)&(yy>=104)&(yy<=150)&(~green)
    if int(mask.sum())<25:
        # loosen the ROI if the hand moved substantially
        mask=(D>.68)&(D<1.075)&(xx>=105)&(xx<=215)&(yy>=90)&(yy<=170)&(~green)
    z=D[mask].astype(float)
    if len(z)<10: raise RuntimeError('hand not visible in calibrated depth ROI')
    u=xx[mask].astype(float); v=yy[mask].astype(float)
    camxyz=np.stack([(u-cx)*z/f,(cy-v)*z/f,-z,np.ones_like(z)],axis=0)
    world=(T@camxyz)[:3,:].T
    # central point of foreground hand surface; robust median resists occlusion and stray depth pixels
    return np.median(world,axis=0), int(mask.sum()), world

def get_state(cameras=('top',), depth=True):
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=cameras,include_depth=depth,video='mp4')
    return o

def act(q, seconds=0.7, note=''):
    q=np.clip(np.asarray(q,float),low,high)
    o=r.submit('joint_position',q[None,:],dt=seconds,interpolate='linear',cameras=('top',),video='mp4',include_depth=True,note=note)
    return o

"""Limited-mode camera/proprioception controller for marker / staples_marker / write_c.

Only the documented RCB client is used. The controller localizes the visible object
from calibrated RGB-D, approaches with the robot's joint targets, closes a thumb/index
pinch, and checks the task progress supplied by the service.

import os
import sys
import json
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

OUT = "/app/output/recorded_attempt"
CAMERAS = ("top", "front", "oblique")

def _last(res, name):
    rgb = np.asarray(res.last[name])
    depth = np.asarray(res.depth[name])
    if rgb.ndim == 4:
        rgb = rgb[-1]
    if depth.ndim == 3:
        depth = depth[-1]
    return rgb, depth

def _cloud(depth, calibration):
    K = np.asarray(calibration["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(calibration["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    v, u = np.indices(depth.shape)
    z = depth.astype(float)
    cam = np.stack(((u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],
                    (K[1,2]-v)*z/K[1,1], -z, np.ones_like(z)), axis=0)
    return (T @ cam.reshape(4,-1))[:3].reshape(3,*depth.shape).transpose(1,2,0)

def localize_marker(obs):
    """Median world point from the gray marker pixels in the front RGB-D view."""
    rgb, depth = _last(obs, "front")
    y, x = np.indices(depth.shape)
    mask = ((x >= 135) & (x <= 192) & (y >= 128) & (y <= 157) &
            (rgb.mean(axis=2) < 178) & (depth > .84) & (depth < 1.23))
    pts = _cloud(depth, obs.meta["cameras"]["front"])[mask]
    if len(pts) < 40:
        raise RuntimeError("marker not visible in the front RGB-D region")
    return np.median(pts, axis=0)

def _action(r, q, seconds, note):
    res = r.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(q, dtype=float)[None,:],
                   dt=seconds, interpolate="linear", cameras=CAMERAS,
                   video="mp4", include_depth=True, note=note)
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    idx = int(res.meta.get("control_steps", 0))
    res.save(os.path.join(OUT, f"step_{idx:06d}"))
    return res

def _open(q):
    q = q.copy()
    q[7:29] = 0.0
    return q

def _precision_pinch(q):
    q = q.copy()
    # Thumb and index curl toward the narrow marker; the remaining digits stay open.
    q[7:12] = [1.6, -0.30, 1.2, -0.20, 1.5]
    q[12:16] = [1.3, 0.05, 1.5, 1.1]
    q[16:29] = 0.0
    return q

    spec = robot.spec()
    lo = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["lower"], float)
    hi = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["upper"], float)
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="mp4")
    marker = localize_marker(obs)
    q = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][58:87], float)

    q = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][58:87], float)

    print("control steps:", obs.meta.get("control_steps"),
